correctness.rationale: Padberg/Koster–Wagler identify the sole fractional vertex and rank inequality for minimally imperfect graphs. The n maximum cliques are independent (Fourier polynomial nonvanishing), so the fractional apex is simple; each pair indicator is adjacent by n-1 tight max-clique facets. The rank cut therefore removes exactly one simplex. The cyclic matrix determinant lemma yields -1/m, proving volume 1/(m n!). Dirichlet second moments prove the exact mean. The one-dependent exponential bivariate CLT, with covariance [[1,12],[12,164]], and gradient (-12,1) give variance 20. The included verifier passed 122 exact finite checks; additional halfspace enumeration corroborated n=5,7,9. No simulation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact volume defect is a natural geometric quantification of failure of perfection, and the conditional radial CLT gives a structural probabilistic dichotomy between odd antiholes and the established odd-hole Brownian cap. The all-rank formula, exact moment, and variance 20 are mathematically motivated and non-implied by the older unique-fractional-vertex theorem; the work does not rely on a tiny numerical improvement or arbitrary isolated dimension.
